title: Earthquakes of magnitude 4.5 or higher in the last 24 hours (8 Oct 2026)

Magnitude 5.5: west of Macquarie Island, 8 Oct, 12:16 pm IST.
Magnitude 4.5: 39 km NE of Calama, Chile, 8 Oct, 11:05 am IST.
Magnitude 4.7: 47 km W of Tambolaka, Indonesia, 8 Oct, 10:36 am IST.
Magnitude 5: 92 km N of Ruteng, Indonesia, 8 Oct, 10:18 am IST.
